# Copilot instructions

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and [.agents/stack.md](../.agents/stack.md): the project's only instruction
files. If they aren't loaded, read them before changing anything. The rules that matter most:

- Never commit what `.gitignore` keeps out, or edit template-owned files. Never weaken a check.
- Done means AGENTS.md's Definition of done, plus `.agents/stack.md`'s.
